declarations.description:
Plain text that arrives in bursts, such as an LLM answer, revealed at a steady pace behind a caret. Chunks are
buffered and released word by word so the display never trails the received text by more than
`--c2-streaming-text__reveal--max-lag`; when `streaming` turns false the rest is released within
`--c2-streaming-text__reveal--flush-duration` and `reveal-end` fires. Released words fade in, then merge back into
a single text node, so a long answer stays cheap and selectable. `prefers-reduced-motion` prints each chunk at once.

Feed it with `appendText(chunk)`, or by setting `value` to the text received so far.
declarations.name: StreamingText

cssProperties.description: Keeps the newlines of the received text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-streaming-text--white-space

cssProperties.description: Fade-in of each released word. `0s` turns the fade off.
cssProperties.name: --c2-streaming-text__segment--enter-duration

cssProperties.description: Longest the display may trail the received text while streaming.
cssProperties.name: --c2-streaming-text__reveal--max-lag

cssProperties.description: Time to release the rest once `streaming` turns false.
cssProperties.name: --c2-streaming-text__reveal--flush-duration

cssParts.description: Container of the revealed text and the caret.
cssParts.name: text

cssParts.description: Caret shown after the text while it streams or is still being revealed. Draws `--c2-streaming-text__caret--content`.
cssParts.name: caret

members.name: streaming
members.description: More text is coming: shows the caret and marks the element busy. Setting it back to false flushes the backlog.

members.name: reveal
members.description: `smooth` paces the text; `instant` prints each chunk as it arrives. Reduced motion always behaves as `instant`.

members.name: segment
members.description: Unit released and faded in: `word` (the default, also right for CJK) or `grapheme` for a per-character look.

members.name: controller
members.default: new StreamRevealController(this, { maxLag: DEFAULT_MAX_LAG, flushDuration: DEFAULT_FLUSH_DURATION, onRevealEnd: () => this.dispatchEvent(new Event('reveal-end', { bubbles: true, composed: true })), })

members.name: value
members.description: The full text received so far, including the part not revealed yet. Setting a value that extends it appends.

members.name: text
members.description: The full text received so far (same as `value`).

members.name: appendText
members.description: Adds a chunk to the stream.

members.name: clear
members.description: Clears the text and the reveal.

members.name: readTimings
members.description: Reads the pacing and fade timings from the element's CSS variables (resolved on the live container).

members.name: syncText
members.description: Brings the live container up to the controller's revealed length.

members.name: settle
members.description: Moves the first `count` fading segments into the settled text node, in order.

events.description: Fired once per stream, when `streaming` is false and the display has caught up with the received text.
events.name: reveal-end
